How it works Français

What DressYou does

DressYou shows a garment on you before it is bought, and says separately whether the size works.

Two questions come up in front of a garment: how it looks, and which size it needs. DressYou answers each on its own, because an image says nothing about size.

How it works

  1. Your twin

    Photographs of you, taken in the app, make your twin: a generated image of you. You approve it before it is used. The photographs are used for that and nothing else.

  2. Try it on

    From a retailer’s page, DressYou shows the garment on your twin. Every generated image says that it is generated. The image shows how the garment may look; it never answers whether it fits.

  3. The size answer

    A separate answer gives a size, states what it rests on and how sure it is. When it has too little to go on, it says so and names what would give an answer.

Around the try-on

  • A wardrobe

    Everything you own, in one place, ready to combine into outfits.

  • A stylist

    It knows your wardrobe, suggests outfits from it and answers your questions.

  • A friend’s opinion

    Send one outfit for a yes or no, or two to four options for a pick. Friends vote without an account.

Availability

DressYou is coming soon to iPhone and Android, and as a browser extension for the computer. The service is for people aged 18 or over.

Your data

The photographs behind your twin are private. From the app, you can download everything your account holds, or delete it.
